metadata.title: Braid monodromy and the Cartwright--Steger surface
metadata.abstract: Building on the Livne-like construction of Cartwright, Koziarz and Yeung, we construct a closed smooth 4-manifold with a map to the two-sphere whose generic fiber has genus 109 and whose four exceptional fibers are determined by explicit braid and permutation data. A pencil of four-pointed spheres realizes the same global braid monodromy and makes the covering holomorphic. We show that the contraction of its thirty-six exceptional curves is the Cartwright-Steger surface, hence our smooth construction gives a topological description of this complex surface.
